visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a stylized title card overlaying a chaotic, smoky kitchen scene. A male main character wearing a white apron is partially visible through thick white smoke that fills the commercial kitchen space. (2) The camera moves to a close-up of a black wok on a gas stove, where oil and egg yolks are visibly burning and releasing heavy smoke. The character holds a yellow cloth and interacts with the hot wok. (3) The scene shifts to show the character preparing the salted egg yolks properly. He uses a metal spatula to press and stir-fry yolks in bubbling oil until they start to foam. The lighting is bright and industrial. (4) The character adds a large batch of fried potato strips into the foaming egg yolk mixture in the wok. He tosses them vigorously with a spatula to ensure an even coating. (5) Chopped green onions and minced garlic are thrown into the wok. The character continues to stir-fry the mixture. Text overlays provide instructional context. (6) The character uses a shaker to season the dish with salt and pepper. Finally, he is shown holding a plate of the finished golden-brown fries, picking one up with chopsticks and eating it with a satisfied expression.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic BGM starts immediately. A male voice with high arousal and pitch variability speaks excitedly, mimicking a news reporter in a war zone. Intense, broadband sizzling from the wok is audible. (2) A sharp transition SFX leads to a conversation about the burnt egg yolks. The male voice is comedic and slightly embarrassed. Sounds of a metal spatula scraping the wok create sharp transients. (3) Narrative shift as the host explains the process. BGM remains constant. A percussive 'thud' sound effect marks a sequence transition. (4) Increased sound event density as ingredients are poured. The sound of frozen potato strips hitting the wok is clear. Sizzling intensity rises and falls. (5) Cartoon-style sound effects punctuate the seasoning phase. A crisp crunching sound is heard as the character bites into the food, followed by muffled speech while eating. (6) The BGM swells slightly before a hard cut at the end. High-frequency 'ding' SFX are used for emphasis throughout.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a humorous cooking vlog designed to entertain while teaching a specific recipe for Salted Egg Yolk Potatoes (金沙馬鈴薯). It uses a 'failure to success' narrative arc to engage viewers through comedy and chaotic kitchen energy.
